source_text:
9.28,29 Ου ἀρᾶς τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ γέ μει ...
̓Εγκάθηται ἐνέδρᾳ μετὰ πλουσίων ἐν ἀποκρύφοις.
̔Ο μὲν δίκαιος εὐλογεῖ τὸν
Κύριον ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ, ὁ δὲ ἁμαρτωλὸς ἐγκάθηται ἐνέδρᾳ.
pass_a_gloss: Of-whom of-curse the mouth of-him is-full ... Sits-in-wait in-ambush with of-rich in hidden-places. The on-the-one-hand righteous blesses the Lord in every season, the on-the-other-hand sinner sits-in-wait in-ambush.
pass_b_english: “He sits in ambush with the rich in secret places” (Psalm 9:29).
The righteous blesses the Lord at every time, but the sinner sits in ambush.

choices.term: Οὗ ἀρᾶς τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ γέμει
choices.english: whose mouth is full of cursing
choices.why: Οὗ relative genitive + ἀρά ‘curse’ + γέμω ‘is full’. Not οὐ + ‘restrain’.
rejected: Do not restrain his mouth, for he is full of cursing

choices.why: OCR γέ μει is one word γέμει. Lock lacuna after it is unrestored.

rejected: is established in a hiding place
is seated in a hiding place

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
